question: Architecture x supervision, with all physical/training/test conditions shared.

physical.channel: Literal printed unnormalized positive-sign steering, sqrt(M/40), independent uniform ray angles and CN(0,1)gains. Same disclosed assumptions as previous reproduction.
physical.reference_definition: Expected total multiuser signal power; known reference/variance.
physical.training_snr: Uniform nominal[-10,20]dB, original20k underlying channel/noise realizations
physical.pilot_bank: Same fixed Gaussian4x35 bank for every arm, first20columns are fitting pilots

training.data: Identical29 noisy pilot measurements available to all four arms. First20 enter each model; last9 are separate measurement targets/validation, never model inputs.
training.initialization: Same spectral initializer and pilot-only unregularized LS operator for both architectures. Spectral initialization is computed only from the20context pilots.
training.orders: Identical epoch permutation seed+20000+epoch for all four arms. Same architecture initial weights across supervision modes.
training.supervised_loss: Mean per-example ||G-H||²/||H||² on true-channel labels; labels used only in supervised workers.
training.selfsupervised_loss: Mean exact Rician NLL on the9withheld magnitude measurements. Observation-only worker never opens true-channel files.
training.selection: Primary: final50epoch weights,identical update counts. Secondary: minimum common heldout Rician validation NLL,epoch0eligible for every arm. No test-based selection.
training.augmentation: Fixed measurement population and fixed20/9split for all arms; no arm-specific augmentation,pretraining,normalization,hyperparameter search or warmstart.
training.comparison_limit: Matched examples/updates/settings,not equal training FLOPs or a proof of best achievable convergence. True labels are training targets,never inference inputs.

test.fresh: Fresh physical channels/noise independent of every earlier test; common channels/noise across SNR,pilot count,arms,seeds.
test.primary: P20SNRsweep; each model trained forP20. Pilot-count sweep is equally a transfer diagnostic for all arms.
test.calibration: Each testedP uses power(P) for known reference/noise; same physical inputs for all methods.
test.truth: Used after inference for NMSE/BER scoring only; no phase alignment or channel-dependent calibration.
test.inference: SamePyTorchfloat64backend,common spectral initialization,10learnedstages,no extra EM/filter/recovery. This is the complete ordinary-SNR adaptive core,not the high-SNR hybrid.

ber.detector: Identical exact Rician likelihood over all256jointQPSK hypotheses for every estimate; known-channel detector also reported.
ber.coupling: Same independent data observations,bits,reference,variance for all arms and fits. Pilot/data noise independent.
ber.calibration: Data uses same physical noise/reference as its pilot case; no channel-truth power normalization.

runtime.included: Completebatch1call: conversion,common spectral initializer,pilot solve,and all model stages. Weights loaded in advance.
runtime.excludes: Data generation,model loading,and common data detector
runtime.order: Both windows after all training/accuracy/BER workers exit. Prespecified random method/case order,no retry or optimization to pass.
runtime.interpretation: Host-specificp90,not per-call deadline; record maxima and overruns.

statistics: Paired channel-bootstrap2000draws,conditional on3fits; preserve SNR/method/fit pairing. Per-seed results retained; fits are not an ensemble.
publication: Published URformer curve excluded from the measured four-arm ranking; this tests our documented implementation,not a verified author-code reproduction.
